page.overview:
Who is Daphne?

Daphne is one of the minor characters in Invincible, debuting from Season 3 and onwards. She is the girlfriend of D.A. Sinclair.

Daphne is a female human, with pink-shirt and a pink business-skirt with a tie. She wears glasses and her hair is black. Daphne also wears a lab white jacket.

Daphne is shown in her dialogue, to be a cold scientist, sounding somewhat devoid of humanity, almost mirroring to her boyfriend who wanted remove humanity in some matter.

Little much is known about her backstory, at some point, Daphne ended up working with the G.D.A and eventually met her love interest, D.A. Sinclair.
